title: Update on internal rework part 3, Passive Search

body.text: Data transfer for catalogue pages (mainly Identities, E.G.Os, and Gifts) have been significantly reduced making them load faster. The following changes have also been added:

texts: Added Passive Search to the build editor for Team Builds and MD Plans, so users can search for Support or E.G.O Passives on the edit page instead of in the Identities/E.G.Os page.
Changed Company to use category toggles instead of display tabs.
Fixed an issue that caused the gifts in the Gifts page to stop showing their tooltips on hover when using filters.
Fixed an issue that caused the spec build recommendation mode for MD Plans to always start with the additional details toggled on.
